Hi Kate — thanks, we have everything we need to start. I reviewed your OrderForm and have attached our marked MSA (initial pass). High-level notes up front:

- Data residency: We can commit to model inference and logging residency per-region as a contractual exhibit; our Private deployment option is typically used where customers need EU-only processing. I'll add a residency exhibit and a short operational note describing region-level routing.

- SLA and credits: Standard 99.9% monthly uptime is included; we can show the credit table in Exhibit C. If you require a higher SLA for pilot customers, we'll need a commercial uplift.

- IP/training data: We will keep customer-provided input/output data separate and will not claim ownership of customer data. For model improvements, we offer an opt-in data usage clause; if Lumenix requires a strict no-training clause, we can add it as an exhibit (this may affect unit pricing).

Outstanding items for Lumenix to confirm (so we can finalise redlines):
1) Signing authority (full name + email) — required for the signature block and DocuSign routing.
2) Billing contact and PO number policy (do you require invoice-level PO numbers?).
3) Residency: confirm if EU-only processing is required for pilot customers, or if regional routing with logged residency is acceptable.

I attached our redline (Lumenix_MSA_v1_redline.docx) and a short exception summary (two pages). We still have one internal question: legal needs to know whether Lumenix requires vendor audit access to system logs (we typically provide SOC2 reports and selective log extracts under NDAs).

I'll be on standby today for any quick calls — Marissa will start mapping the billing exhibits into the Order Form once you return the signer and PO info.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
